hypothesis_experiment.method: Temporary in-memory candidate only; no product source edit; alternating disk-independent CPU samples, three each. Same 500009-char failing fixture. Both variants must preserve prose, redact final credential and remain idempotent.

limitation: Isolated pre-fix timings pass the fixed limit; the original full-run slowdown is not uniquely reconstructed. The profile and deterministic regression establish redundant parser work, and the candidate removes that work without changing the measured outputs.
